title: EEG: Probabilistic Selection and Depression
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from 122 college-age participants performing a probabilistic selection task, collected circa 2008-2010 in the John J.B. Allen laboratory at the University of Arizona. Participants were selected based on reliably high or low scores on the Beck Depression Inventory, with some undergoing clinical interviews. The dataset supports investigation of reinforcement learning and reward-based decision-making processes in relation to depression.
methods_description: EEG data were collected during a probabilistic selection task programmed in DMDX. HEOG and VEOG channels may be mislabeled in some subjects, and some channels have already been interpolated in certain files, with no raw data available to revert to.
